title: fea.loadCase
summary: Create a typed RunMat FEA load or source.
description: `fea.loadCase(id, region, kind, Name, Value, ...)` creates a force, moment, pressure, body-force, current-density, coil-current, or heat-source load.
behaviors: Load id, region selector, and kind are exact text values. `torque` is accepted as an alias for the canonical `moment` kind.
Required vectors contain exactly three finite real numeric values; scalar fields must be finite real numeric scalars.
All eight built-in integer classes are accepted for numeric fields and remain exact until one host-only binary64 model-storage conversion, so sufficiently wide integers can round.
Kind-specific fields and vector shape are validated before the typed load object is created; resident numeric fields are rejected.
integer_forms: Force, moment/torque, body-force, and current-density vectors.
Pressure magnitude, current-density phase and amplitude, coil current phase and amplitude, and volumetric heat-source magnitude.

faqs.question: When is a moment rejected for a solid region?
faqs.answer: The constructor validates load syntax first. Model validation or assembly later rejects direct moments on regions without rotational degrees of freedom.
